◌

Smart+

The opt-in half of ArticleFlux. Everything here sends text to OpenAI and costs money on your own account. Nothing here runs until you add a key, and nothing on this server calls out without one.
◈

How Smart+ decides

A yes/no or pick-one question goes up these steps in order and stops at the first that can answer. Anything that has to be written skips the middle step.
On this machineAnswers first, whenever its rule is clear. Free, and nothing leaves this server.
always on
JEVTypeSafe's decision model. It is asked only yes/no and pick-one questions — what an article is about, which folder a feed goes in, which article leads — and it cannot write text.
no key
The modelgpt-x, on your OpenAI key. Asked when JEV cannot answer or is not set up, and for everything that has to be written: summaries, translations, themes.
ready
Both paid steps count against the same spend limit, and each is billed on its own key.
⚡

OpenAI API key

Stored on this server, encrypted. It is never sent back to this screen — the last four characters are shown so you can tell which key it is.
configured · ending 4f2a
This server has no encryption key on disk, so it will not store a credential. Set OPENAI_API_KEY in its environment instead.
⚡

JEV decision key

Stored on this server, encrypted, like the OpenAI key. It is never sent back to this screen — the last four characters are shown so you can tell which key it is.
not configured
This server has no encryption key on disk, so it will not store a credential. Set SCHEMAFLUX_TYPESAFE_API_KEY in its environment instead.
RouteWhere decisions are sent. TypeSafe and OpenRouter have fixed addresses; a LiteLLM proxy is your own.
◍

Model

One model for every Smart+ feature, so what they cost can be compared. Leave it blank for the default.
Default: gpt-x
◈

What Smart+ is allowed to do

Each one is off until you turn it on, and each one is a separate bill.
Smart+ rankingSends the top forty headlines and a summary of your interests each time your feed is rebuilt — after every fetch, and shortly after you read something. My Feed works without this; the model only reorders what it already chose.
